name: Penguin Warden Sue

intro.text: Kings, gentoos, rockhoppers, Magellanics. The island has five kinds of penguin, and I have had a talking-to from all of them.

win: A fine bit of fieldcraft. The penguins will talk.
after: Penguins in the Falklands have faced changes in fish stocks and weather, and the islands' wardens and visitors count the nests every year.
